text:
mike: Hey — quick question: I opened a PR that touches src/runtime/cache and src/console/ui. Who needs to approve this for merge? CODEOWNERS points to eng-runtime for runtime but not 100% sure about console. Short link: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/428>.
sophia: FYI CODEOWNERS usually dictates auto-reviewers. If both dirs are owned by different teams we need an approver from each owner. Which exact files are changed?
mike: Files are src/runtime/cache/* and src/console/ui/cache-panel.jsx — looks like /src/console is listed under @eng-platform/console-team in CODEOWNERS but console subpath might not be explicit in some cases. Do we require two separate approvals or can one owner + platform lead approve?
raju: For cross-team changes we prefer explicit approvers from each owning team. If urgent, you can request an owner-override from eng-platform leads. Tagging @kate to confirm console side. :eyes:
kate: Confirming — console ownership sits with eng-platform. I can do a review but if the change affects runtime semantics we should still get eng-runtime +1. My preference: two approvals (one per owning team).
mike: OK will ping runtime. Also, should I add a label like `needs-cross-team-approval` to make it obvious?
sophia: Yes please add `needs-cross-team-approval` and include a 2-3 line summary of the risk and a minimal test plan in the PR description. That helps reviewers prioritize.
mike: Done — added label and updated PR description with test plan. Pinged @raju and @taro in the PR comment. If there's no response in 24h I'll mark as `urgent-merge` and loop in leads. :shipit:
codeowner-bot: CODEOWNERS match: /src/runtime/ -> @eng-runtime, /src/console/ -> @eng-platform. Auto-requested reviewers: @eng-runtime, @eng-platform.
raju: Got the ping, starting a quick pass now. If tests are green I'll approve before EOD.
